description: SPEC §7.2 item 2 (payload schema) is checked over the payload AS RECEIVED, not over the payload decoded into the consumer's type and re-encoded. A typed decode reads a `null` on an optional member whose schema has no null form as absent, so a re-encoded payload would pass a check the received one fails. Each case consumes `document` (JSON text) with the typed consume function, the received document in hand, against `implements`, under a payload-validating policy, no proof, no replay record, as `consumer` at `now`. `verdict` is `accept` or the code it is refused with. `validated` is the payload the validator must be handed: the received payload for a document of the implemented version, and for a later version read forward along `extends` the received payload pruned to the members the implemented schema knows, as a routed (dispatched) consumer prunes it. A runtime whose tests bundle no JSON Schema engine may check `implements.payloadSchema` by hand: an object, `subject` present, every member named in `properties`, every member a string.

cases.name: an optional member with a value
a null on an optional member whose schema has no null form is refused, though decoding reads it as absent
a later version read forward is validated pruned, so its added member does not refuse it
a later version's forbidden null on a member the implemented version knows is refused
a later version's null on a member only it declares is pruned before validation
